binding_provenance: te-new-capabilities-spec.md §#1 (locked 2026-05-24, chat QGI-R&D | 002). Bins pre-registered before results: [0,0.5), [0.5,0.7), [0.7,0.85), [0.85,0.95), [0.95,1.0]. Suppression at n<5. No FDR.
m8_r5_note: M8-R5 BINDING: frequency of realized events among similarly-scoring country-years, OUT OF FOLD. This is the discrimination layer's track record, NOT a calibrated probability. ppv = n_positive / n per bin (OOF only). Wilson 95% CI reported; suppressed bins (n<5) flagged INSUFFICIENT_DATA. Never label ppv as 'probability'.
sampling_disclosure: The OOF set is built by the walk's 1:3 positive:negative LOCO sampling, NOT a prevalence-matched cohort. Absolute PPV figures reflect this 1:3 construction and must NOT be read as a real-world hit rate. They are comparative (high bins vs low bins vs the in-sample baseline_rate, which is itself the 1:3 base). Prevalence-matched track-record is a Stage-B enrichment (score more negatives OOF) — deferred (#110).
